name: medium-research-lobsters
description: Lobsters research with normalized MCP output. Wraps the public lobste.rs .json endpoints (lobsters_hottest, lobsters_tag, lobsters_get, plus a client-side lobsters_search over the hottest window). Runs fully keyless — Lobsters needs no credentials, so there is no user_config. Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.
